entities.summary: Aaron Steven Laffey is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut with the Cleveland Indians in 2007. He played in MLB with the Seattle Mariners, New York Yankees, Toronto Blue Jays, New York Mets, and Colorado Rockies, ending his tenure in MLB in 2015 and retiring as a player in 2018.
